title: CokeDrink
description: This adds a drink called coke, which regenerates 5 hunger points.
body:
This mod adds some new things to minecraft. One of them is the coke. The other one is the "suger water".
You make the sugar water by putting two sugar on the very top of the crafting table and the very bottom.You can either eat the suger water, or you can use it to craft it into coke.
